# Classic Algorithms in Python

Below are four fundamental algorithms with thorough inline comments explaining the logic, invariants, and complexity at every step.

## 1. Quicksort

```python
def quicksort(arr: list) -> list:
    """
    Sorts a list in-place using the Quicksort algorithm.

    Strategy:
        1. Pick a "pivot" element (here: the last element).
        2. Partition the array so that:
             - all elements < pivot are on the LEFT
             - all elements > pivot are on the RIGHT
             - the pivot sits in its final sorted position
        3. Recursively sort the left and right sub-arrays.

    Time Complexity:
        - Average:  O(n log n)
        - Worst:    O(n²)   (already-sorted input with last-element pivot)
    Space Complexity:
        - O(log n)
